title: Olympian Ruivivar 'proud' of PH women's gymnastics team's performance in Asiad
summary: Olympian Levi Ruivivar expressed pride and optimism following the sixth-place finish of the Philippine Women's Artistic Gymnastics Team in the Women's Team Final at the 20th Asian Games.
